close.where: Every dialog and side sheet: screen-reader label of the X close button

sectionFailed.where: Manage pages and Perform overlays: heading when one section of the page crashed
sectionFailed.context: {label} is the section's name (passed in by the caller)

retry.where: Error boxes: button that re-renders the failed section

somethingWentWrong.where: Error boxes: default heading when a part of the page crashed or failed to load

unexpectedRenderError.where: Error box: default message when the crash carried no message

couldNotLoad.where: Error state (library, setlists): default message when data failed to load

keyPlaceholder.where: Key picker (setlist grid, Perform): button text when no musical key is set
keyPlaceholder.context: the musical key of a song (C, G, Am...)

major.where: Key picker: toggle choosing major keys

minor.where: Key picker: toggle choosing minor keys

clear.where: Key picker: button removing the song's key

tap.where: Tap-tempo button: label before any tap

tapAgain.where: Tap-tempo button: label after the first tap (keep tapping)
